elements.title: PYTHON CODE
elements.details: Screenshot of Python code demonstrating cross validation with Bayesian Information Criterion (BIC). The code imports necessary libraries, defines a decision tree classifier, performs 5-fold cross-validation, prints average accuracy, defines a parameter grid for grid search, performs grid search with cross-validation, prints best parameters and score, calculates and prints BIC score. The resulting output is shown as printed text with average accuracy 0.41, best parameters {'max_depth': 1, 'min_samples_leaf': 1, 'min_samples_split': 2}, best score 0.72, and BIC score 2165.56.
elements.summary: This code snippet illustrates how to perform cross-validation and grid search for a decision tree classifier, and how to calculate the Bayesian Information Criterion (BIC) to balance model fit and complexity.
